classification.difficultyReason: Calculate journey endpoints and rest times, construct the supplied piecewise journeys, then interpret intersections and remaining distance.

content.prompt: Tom begins in Mildura and travels a distance of 300 km to Broken Hill at a constant speed of 80 km/h. Steve, beginning at the same time, travels at a constant speed of 100 km/h from Mildura to Broken Hill with a 30-minute rest after travelling 150 km.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Let $d$ be the distance (in km) from Mildura, and $t$ the time (in hours) after Tom and Steve leave Mildura. On a single set of axes, draw graphs to illustrate the journeys of Tom and Steve ($d$ against $t$).

answer.worked:
Tom travels at a constant speed throughout.
$$\begin{align*}t_{\text{Tom}} &= \frac{300}{80}\\t_{\text{Tom}} &= 3.75\text{ h}\end{align*}$$
Draw Tom’s straight segment from $(0,0)$ to $(3.75,300)$.

Steve reaches 150 km after:
$$\begin{align*}t_{\text{first stage}} &= \frac{150}{100}\\t_{\text{first stage}} &= 1.5\text{ h}\end{align*}$$
His rest ends at $t=2$ h. The remaining 150 km takes another 1.5 h, so he arrives at $t=3.5$ h. Join $(0,0)$, $(1.5,150)$, $(2,150)$ and $(3.5,300)$ with straight segments. The horizontal segment represents his rest.

spec.description: A single set of distance–time axes containing both complete journeys. Steve uses a solid blue line; Tom uses a dashed black line with an explicit legend.
spec.mathematics: Tom joins (0,0) to (3.75,300). Steve joins (0,0), (1.5,150), (2,150), (3.5,300). Axes have hourly and 100 km ticks; no grid.

children.label: i
children.prompt: when and where Tom overtakes Steve

answer.short: After $1$ hour $52\frac12$ minutes, 150 km from Mildura.
answer.worked:
Tom’s graph crosses Steve’s horizontal rest segment at $(1.875,150)$.
$$\begin{align*}1.875\text{ h} &= 1\text{ h}+0.875\times60\text{ min}\\1.875\text{ h} &= 1\text{ h }52\tfrac12\text{ min}\end{align*}$$
Tom overtakes Steve 150 km from Mildura.

children.label: ii
children.prompt: when and where Steve overtakes Tom

answer.worked: After Steve’s rest, the two rising graph segments intersect at $(2.5,200)$. Steve overtakes Tom after $2\frac12$ hours, 200 km from Mildura.

children.label: iii
children.prompt: the distance Tom still has to travel to Broken Hill at the time Steve arrives at Broken Hill

answer.worked:
Steve arrives at $t=3.5$ h. At this time, Tom’s graph gives $d=280$ km.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Remaining distance} &= 300-280\\\text{Remaining distance} &= 20\text{ km}\end{align*}$$
